summary: A bounded pre-result statistical contract is available for one five-component quadrupolar variance-modulation feature of the released ACT DR6 baseline reconstructed kappa field on integer multipoles 40 through 763 inclusive. It uses one observed unit and exactly 400 release simulations under one permutation-equivariant pipeline, calibrates only a single global score, carries an explicit M_K^2 mask-nuisance control and veto, and requires full 400-way delete-independent-simulation recomputation before any candidate or null route. This is a contract verdict only; no PR-177 numerical or scientific result was inspected or produced.

findings.statement: The registered evidence supports a low-dimensional release-simulation-conditional variance-modulation diagnostic, but not a full off-diagonal covariance fit, raw-QE reproduction, detection, isotropy proof, geometry claim, or family identification. The proposed contract is falsifiable and terminally closed before observed results are viewed.

claim_results.reason: No in-band PR-177 score, rank, mask-control result, or delete-one resolution receipt was in the assignment evidence.

estimand_choice.reason: A five-component quadrupole is a bounded compression that 400 release simulations can calibrate. An unrestricted 40..763 off-diagonal covariance is not identified at this ensemble size.
estimand_choice.model_definition: For the hard-band field x(n), define its fractional local-variance quadrupole q in a fixed real ell=2 basis. On the full sky this quadratic is an ell=2 BiPoSH/off-diagonal coupling of kappa modes. It is an observable feature, not a deterministic Bianchi template and not a stochastic geometry likelihood.

inputs.simulation_identity_requirement: exactly 400 unique authenticated reconstructed baseline kappa simulations with independent release-unit lineage

analysis_multipoles.endpoint_note: The backlog also contains strict-inequality prose. This contract follows the assignment's inclusive 40<=L<=763 definition; every spec, code path, test, caption, and artifact must use the same endpoint convention before scores are viewed.

inputs.exchangeability_assumption: The observed released reconstruction and the 400 released reconstructed simulations are jointly exchangeable for this fixed feature after identical processing, conditional on the release simulation law. This is an assumption and claim boundary, not an ACT validation result.

conventions.alm_storage: healpy m>=0 indexing with real-field completion a_L,-M=(-1)^M conjugate(a_LM)

pixelization.mask_downgrade: area-average power=0 from release nside 4096, then threshold

feature_equations.raw_fit: On W=1 pixels, equal-area least squares fits v_u=c_u+sum_alpha b_raw[u,alpha] R_alpha+e_u, where the five R_alpha are the fixed real ell=2 columns.
feature_equations.controlled_fit: On the identical pixels, equal-area least squares fits v_u=c_u+beta_u s+sum_alpha b_ctl[u,alpha] R_alpha+e_u. Columns are centered and unit-normed on W before solving; the exact back-transformation to physical coefficients is recorded.
feature_equations.fractional_vectors: q_raw[u]=b_raw[u]/mean_W(v_u), q_ctl[u]=b_ctl[u]/mean_W(v_u); mean_W(v_u) must be finite and strictly positive.
feature_equations.harmonic_interpretation: Because the ell=2 coefficient of x_u^2 is a Gaunt-weighted quadratic in a_LM and a_L'M', q is an off-diagonal/variance-modulation feature. No inverse map from q to a physical geometry is defined.

identical_crossfit_scoring.unit_index: u=0 is observed; u=1..400 are simulations, but the scoring function is blind to that label
identical_crossfit_scoring.inverse_factor: h(n_ref,d)=(n_ref-d-2)/(n_ref-1), with n_ref=400 and d=5, so h=393/399 for the full 401-unit analysis
identical_crossfit_scoring.covariance_gate: Every 5x5 C[-u] must be finite, symmetric, positive definite, and have 2-norm condition number <=1e8 after the frozen basis normalization. No adaptive PCA, eigenvalue clipping, or result-dependent shrinkage is allowed; failure routes to unresolved/no result.
identical_crossfit_scoring.permutation_equivariance: Relabeling any of the 401 input units must only relabel the three score arrays. A simulation score is not allowed to use a data-excluding transform unavailable to the observed score.

rank_contract.look_elsewhere: There is one frozen global five-dimensional score. Orientation is absorbed by the quadratic norm, not scanned. Any extra band split, weighting, mask cut, map variant, or component selection is a new preregistered analysis unless its maximum is recalibrated inside every unit.

full_delete_independent_unit_resolution.independent_deletion_units: the 400 release simulation identities; the observed unit is never deleted
full_delete_independent_unit_resolution.full_recomputation: For each simulation k, remove k, then rerun from primitive alms the band restriction, map synthesis, raw and controlled fits, all leave-one-out centers/covariances/scores for the remaining observed+399 simulations, and all three plus-one ranks. Reusing a full-sample mean, covariance, score, or deleting only one exceedance indicator is forbidden.
full_delete_independent_unit_resolution.interpretation: This is a numerical-resolution guard for the release-ensemble rank functional, not physical uncertainty, null-model validation, or a coverage theorem beyond the registered independent-unit assumption.
full_delete_independent_unit_resolution.failure_rule: Missing deletion lineage, non-finite replicate, incomplete recomputation, or a guard interval crossing 0.05 prevents a resolved decision.

mask_leakage_control.primary_feature: q_ctl from the simultaneous M_K^2 nuisance fit on the README-recommended M_K>=0.99 core
mask_leakage_control.comparison_feature: q_raw from the same pixels and transform but without the M_K^2 nuisance column
mask_leakage_control.veto_score: D=||q_raw-q_ctl||^2, ranked with the same 401-unit plus-one and 400-way delete-one contracts
candidate_requirements: The controlled global rank is resolved below alpha.
The raw global rank is also resolved below alpha, preventing a modulation candidate created only by nuisance projection.
The mask-change rank is resolved above alpha, so the observed raw-to-controlled change is not an exceptional release-simulation outlier.
The design matrix and covariance gates pass for all full and delete-one fits.
mask_leakage_control.scope_limit: M_K^2 regression plus release-simulation calibration is a bounded leakage diagnostic, not an exact MASTER deconvolution or reconstruction-stage validation.

terminal_routing.eligibility_gate: Exact support/count/hash/lineage, identical-pipeline, finite design/covariance, complete metadata, and complete delete-one recomputation must pass before any scientific terminal label. An integrity failure is BLOCKED_NO_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT, not one of the three scientific outcomes.
terminal_routing.ACT_RELEASE_SIMULATION_CONDITIONAL_MODUL: Emit only if G_ctl.upper<0.05, G_raw.upper<0.05, and G_D.lower>0.05, with every eligibility and mask gate passing.
terminal_routing.NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOL: Emit if G_ctl.lower>0.05. Also emit, with an explicit mask-control reason, if G_ctl.upper<0.05 but the raw score is resolved non-candidate or the mask-change score is resolved exceptional; this means no coupling survives the frozen control, not that the sky is isotropic.
terminal_routing.NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUD: Emit for every eligible case whose controlled rank or required raw/mask guard straddles 0.05, or whose complete delete-one numerical guard cannot separate the required branches.
terminal_routing.closed_world_rule: No fourth scientific label, Gaussian significance, componentwise discovery, or post-hoc threshold is permitted. Structural integrity failures remain blocked outside the scientific routing.

claim_boundary.safe_positive: ACT-release-simulation-conditional quadrupolar variance-modulation candidate on reconstructed baseline kappa over inclusive L=40..763, after the frozen mask control, at resolved finite-ensemble rank resolution.
claim_boundary.safe_null: No resolved coupling under this one frozen ACT-release-simulation-conditional feature and current 400-simulation resolution.
forbidden: native transfer or native solver validation
claim_boundary.covariance_status: empirical exactly-400 ACT release reconstructed simulations conditional on exchangeability
claim_boundary.null_status: exactly 400 release simulations; not an external matched-null validation
claim_boundary.sky_mask_status: release baseline support, Equatorial M_K>=0.99 core, M_K^2 nuisance diagnostic; reconstruction support not independently reprocessed

falsifiers.condition: The observed baseline alm, release mask, or any of the 400 ordered baseline simulation alms is missing, duplicated, byte-drifted, non-unique, or lacks independent release-unit lineage.
Any nonzero mode outside inclusive integer L=40..763 enters, or code/spec/caption alternates between strict and inclusive endpoint conventions.
Observed and simulation units differ in bandpass, map synthesis, coordinate frame, mask, regression, centering, covariance, scoring, or cross-fit membership logic.
Relabeling the 401 units changes scores beyond the corresponding relabeling.
Mask bytes, coordinate/order metadata, nside conversion, M_K>=0.99 support, M_K^2 template, column normalization, rank, or conditioning is missing or inconsistent.

The controlled candidate is absent in the raw branch, the raw candidate disappears in the controlled branch, or the observed raw-to-controlled change is a resolved upper-tail outlier relative to the 400 simulations.
falsifiers.effect: candidate_forbidden; route NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING if resolved, otherwise NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED

falsifiers.condition: Any five-dimensional leave-one-out covariance is non-finite, non-positive-definite, condition number exceeds 1e8, or is rescued by adaptive regularization/PCA chosen after viewing scores.
falsifiers.effect: NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET or BLOCKED if the contract was changed

falsifiers.condition: The rank omits the plus one, uses a lower or two-sided tail, treats ties as less than, reports finer support than 1/401, or converts the rank to Gaussian sigma.

Fewer or more than 400 unique simulation deletions are used, the data are deleted, a deletion reuses full-sample transformations, only an exceedance indicator is removed, or any deletion output is non-finite.
Any guard interval needed by a proposed branch intersects 0.05 or merely touches it.

Band edges, weights, orientation, component, mask threshold, map variant, or statistic are selected after observed results without recalibrating a preregistered global maximum inside every unit and every deletion.
Owner, scope, claim tier, transfer source, config/input hashes, sky/mask status, covariance/null status, caveats, command, runtime, git/worktree state, or forbidden uses are absent.
Any output calls the feature a detection, isotropy proof, raw-QE result, physical anisotropy, global tilt, geometry, Bianchi family, or native-transfer validation.

assumptions: The released reconstructed baseline kappa alms and exactly 400 baseline reconstructed simulations are the complete authorized inputs.
Conditional exchangeability is required for the pooled rank.
The release mask and simulations calibrate the bounded feature but do not validate the reconstruction or physical sky model.
physics_math_audit.dimensional_checks: kappa and the fractional q components are dimensionless; T and D ranks are dimensionless probabilities. No dimensional rank floor is combined with a physical-unit interval.
physics_math_audit.sign_checks: The candidate uses a rotational quadratic norm, so real-basis sign choices do not alter T, but exact real-harmonic component signs and ordering remain manifest metadata.
limit_checks: Isotropic full-sky release-law limit: the expected centered q vector is zero, without implying a realized score is zero.
Zero mask-nuisance limit: q_raw=q_ctl and D=0.
Rank-deficient covariance/design limit: no adaptive promotion; route unresolved/blocked.
No raw-QE limit: no estimator-stage reconstruction or RDN0 quantity is emitted.
Scalar-feature limit: a q norm cannot identify anisotropic geometry or a Bianchi family.
physics_math_audit.proof_derivation_status: The variance-quadrupole/off-diagonal equivalence is an algebraic feature definition. Release-simulation calibration and any eventual numerical rank are empirical conditional results. No physical model derivation is claimed.

Any high-dimensional covariance expansion, alternate bands, or variants would exceed this frozen estimand and require a new analysis.
